name: mcc-test-harness
description: jsdom for tests/api/admin_jsdom_harness.mjs. Nothing MCC ships imports this; it exists so the dashboard's admin.js can be executed by tests/api/test_admin_static_jsdom.py. It lives in tests/ rather than tests/jsdom/ because node resolves a bare import by walking up from the harness, and tests/ is the nearest directory both the harness and the CI job can agree on. Install with `npm ci --prefix tests`.
